mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.report_type, r.athlete_id, r.dept_id, r.task_id, r.template_version, r.content_snapshot, r.file_path, r.generate_by, r.generate_time, a.name AS a_name, a.gender AS a_gender, d.dept_name, t.task_name AS t_name, d2.dept_name AS d2_name FROM apms_report r LEFT JOIN apms_athlete a ON r.athlete_id = a.athlete_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN apms_test_task t ON r.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d2 ON r.dept_id = d2.dept_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_report (report_type, athlete_id, dept_id, task_id, template_version, content_snapshot, file_path, generate_by, generate_time) VALUES (#{reportType}, #{athleteId}, #{deptId}, #{taskId}, #{templateVersion}, #{contentSnapshot}, #{filePath}, #{generateBy}, #{generateTime})
